linkedin.text:
Some venues need a production budget to feel special. This one needed a sunset.

The Amalfi Coast, shot from our own drone during a site production. Terraced towns, a thousand feet of cliff, and the Tyrrhenian going gold at seven in the evening.

For an incentive group this coastline does something specific: it removes the need to impress anyone. You do not decorate a view like this. You just seat people facing it and get out of the way.

The logistics are the real work — cliff roads that do not take coaches, restaurants with 40-cover ceilings, and ferry timings that decide your whole evening. That is our job, not yours.

Thinking about southern Italy for 2026? Let's talk about what your group actually needs the coastline to do.

Uproduction Events — From Business to Pleasure

📩 alon@upe.co.il
